shortDescription: Industrial metals retreated after a key London Metal Exchange price gauge surged to an all-time high, according to Bloomberg.The move came as escalating hostilities in the Middle East underscored lingering headwinds.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Industrial Metals Pull Back From London Record as Middle East Tensions Rise
